titleEn: Conditionals: if it rains, if I had
explanationAr: الشرط الأول لاحتمال حقيقي في المستقبل: If it rains, we will stop the work. وبعد if نستخدم المضارع، لا will. والشرط الثاني لحالة غير حقيقية أو بعيدة في الحاضر: If I had more time, I would take another course. والشرط الثالث لماضٍ لم يحدث: If we had checked the levels, we would have avoided the problem. الخطأ الشائع: If it will rain.
explanationEn: First conditional, for a real possibility: If it rains, we will stop the work. Use the present after if, not will. Second conditional, for an unreal or unlikely present: If I had more time, I would take another course. Third conditional, for a past that did not happen: If we had checked the levels, we would have avoided the problem.

comparison.en: If it rains, we will stop the work.
comparison.noteAr: بعد if نستخدم المضارع rains، لا will rain.

comparison.ar: لو كان عندي وقت أكثر، لأخذتُ دورة أخرى.
comparison.en: If I had more time, I would take another course.
comparison.noteAr: حالة غير حقيقية: had ثم would.

examples.en: If the pressure drops, the system will stop the pump.
examples.ar: إذا انخفض الضغط، سيوقف النظام المضخة.

examples.en: If I were you, I would ask the supervisor.
If we had ordered earlier, the steel would have arrived on time.
examples.ar: لو طلبنا مبكرًا، لوصل الحديد في موعده.

examples.en: Unless you save the file, you will lose your changes.
examples.ar: إذا لم تحفظ الملف، ستفقد تعديلاتك.

exercises.prompt: If the test ___, we will start production.
exercises.explanationAr: بعد if في الشرط الأول نستخدم المضارع: passes.

exercises.sentence: If I will see him, I will tell him.
accepted: If I see him, I will tell him.
If I see him, I'll tell him.
exercises.explanationAr: لا نستخدم will بعد if: If I see him.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (have) a car, I would drive to work.
exercises.explanationAr: حالة غير حقيقية: If I had..., I would...

exercises.prompt: If we had left earlier, we ___ the traffic.
exercises.explanationAr: ماضٍ لم يحدث: would have avoided.

exercises.sentence: If I would know the answer, I would tell you.
accepted: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
exercises.explanationAr: بعد if نستخدم الماضي knew، لا would know.

exercises.prompt: Unless you ___ the valve, the water will not flow.
